definitions.explanation: A common viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
{風邪|かぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}った→直る：00735_naoru⟧。
{風邪|かぜ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I was absent from school because of a cold.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{寝|ね}よう→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I caught a cold, so I'm going to go to bed early today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風邪|かぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}きやすい→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧、⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ようにしている。
examples.english: It's easy to catch a cold in winter, so I make sure to wash my hands and get plenty of sleep.

notes:
A common viral illness. One of the most frequently discussed health topics in daily Japanese conversation.

WRITING:
Written {風邪|かぜ} — same reading as ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind) but different kanji. The ⟦{邪|じゃ}→邪：noentry⟧ character means "evil/harmful."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {風邪|かぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to catch a cold (the standard expression — uses {引|ひ}く, not かかる)
- {風邪|かぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→直る：00735_naoru⟧: to recover from a cold
- {風邪|かぜ}⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧: feeling a bit under the weather
- {風邪|かぜ}⟦{薬|ぐすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: cold medicine
- {風邪|かぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}きやすい→引く：01978_hiku⟧: prone to catching colds

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, wearing a mask (⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧) when you have a cold is standard etiquette. The phrase ⟦お{大事|だいじ}に→お大事に：26564_odaijini⟧ (take care) is the customary response when someone says they have a cold.
